iBothSetsTip: Two in-phase sets, each on its own controller: each set carries the current entered above, both sets together carry twice that. The solver, the stored duty and the report quote both sets; read-only.
magnetTempTip: The temperature the magnets are solved at. The {card} card is quoted at {cardC} °C and is derived to this temperature: Br, the coercivity and the whole demagnetisation curve including the knee. Grey = nothing typed: the card's own {cardC} °C is used. At most {max} °C (the grade's maximum working temperature). Saved with the duty; the result card says which temperature was used.
magnetTempLoopTip: From the coupled loop: the magnet AVERAGE the last converged run settled on (the hottest element is on the summary card). Switch the loop off to type a temperature.
accountForIrreversibleMagnetDemagnetisat: Account for irreversible magnet demagnetisation. A pre-pass sweeps the whole period at full strength, finds the worst demagnetising field H at EVERY magnet element, and permanently de-rates Br along the recoil line where H crosses the BH-curve knee (per element, like commercial FEM). The torque and back-EMF then reflect the weakened magnets, and a Demag-% map is produced. COST — measured, not modest: the pre-pass is a WHOLE EXTRA PERIOD of FEM frames, so the run solves twice the steps you asked for, and each frame re-solves while the magnet is still moving. On the 40 mm 12s/14p at 0.6 mm mesh, 4 steps/period: 37 s off → 86 s on (2.3×). The line under the Run button shows the frame count your current settings imply.
coupledThermalSolveForTheTemperatures: Coupled thermal — solve for the temperatures
optVarsActAddAll: Add all geometry ({count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}})
optVarsActRemoveAll: Remove all ({count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}})
optVarsActReset: Reset ranges to current ±10 % ({count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}})
optVarsResetTip: These ranges do not contain the current value of the loaded motor (they may have been set for another motor). One click re-centres them on the current value ±10 %. Undo brings them back.
optVarsManageTip: Choose which parameters can be varied: the Optimizable switch on each row of the Geometry tab.
propellersLoadFailed: The propeller catalogue could not be loaded: {error}
propellersColBladesTip: Number of blades; a dash means the vendor does not state it.
propellersColDataTip: How the thrust and power data of this propeller were obtained. Only propellers with measured or explicitly estimated power can be used for loads; geometry-only entries cannot.
propellersColRpmTip: Highest rpm of the published bench tests. Outside the tested range the coefficients are held at the edge value.
propellersQuality_measuredTip: Thrust and torque come from a published bench table.
propellersQuality_powerEstimatedTip: Thrust is measured; shaft power is an estimate with a stated method, not a measurement.
propellersQuality_geometryOnlyTip: No usable test data: listed for reference, the model refuses to compute loads for it.
propDesignBanner: BEMT, generic airfoil polars, not validated
propDesignBannerTip: Every number on this page comes from a blade-element model with estimated section polars. It has not been compared with a measurement; the root flow at the motor is the weakest part.
propDesignDiameterTip: Propeller family 10 / 11 / 12 / 13 in: the planform scales with the diameter; hub radius and manufacturing minima stay in mm.
propDesignBladesTip: 2 and 3 blades are both offered; compare them at equal diameter and equal thrust.
propDesignMotorTip: The propeller is evaluated at the speed where it absorbs the motor's torque limit (stored rated duty of the catalog).
propDesignDraftsTip: Drafts are stored in your own workspace, never in the shared catalogue.
propDesignGroupInnerTip: Controls the flow behind the hub: it barely carries thrust but sets the air at the motor.
propDesignBoundsBasis: Bounds are placeholders (geometric validity), not manufacturing limits.
propTileEffTip: Objective 1: thrust divided by shaft power at the motor's torque limit.
propTileAirTip: Objective 2: mean axial speed at the disc over the radius band the motor occupies behind the hub. Empty where the model has no value.
propTileTorqueTip: The motor's torque limit is the constraint; the speed is found where the propeller absorbs it.
propTileMachTip: Tip speed over the speed of sound; the limit is an unconfirmed owner input.
propFlagTip_root_flow_not_validated: The blade-element model has no information inside the hub and is weakest at the root; the air speed at the motor must be checked with the thrust-stand anemometer and CFD before it is trusted.
propFlagTip_design_inputs_unconfirmed: Bounds, blade options and the tip-speed limit are placeholders until the owner confirms them.
propFlagTip_manufacturing_limits_unconfi: No manufacturing limit has been confirmed by the factory yet; stated limits are applied, unset ones are not.
propFlagTip_airfoil_choice_not_resolved_: With the estimated flat-plate polar the airfoil changes drag only, not lift; airfoil choice needs library polars.
propFlagTip_high_tip_mach: Tip Mach above 0.6: compressibility is not modelled and noise rises.
propFlagTip_rpm_capped: The propeller does not absorb the torque limit below the speed search bound.
propChartPlanformTip: Blade outline around the pitch axis (leading edge up) and the twist angle along the radius; the motor radius is marked.
propChartProfileTip: Axial speed through the disc and swirl by radius; the band the motor occupies is shaded. Inside the hub the model has no value.
propChartCurvesTip: Torque and thrust at constant speed steps with the motor's torque limit; where the curve crosses the limit is the operating speed.
propZonesTip: Chosen airfoil, thickness ratio before and after the manufacturing limits, trailing-edge thickness and the limit that is active.
propParetoTip: Each run is a point: thrust per shaft watt against air speed at the motor. The line joins the runs that no other run beats on both. The cost is read off the line; pick the point you want.
propParetoCost: Efficiency given up per m/s gained: {value} g/W
propParetoNone: Evaluate or sweep to add runs
propSweepTip: Evaluate the design with ONE variable changed: from the first to the last value in equal steps; every point becomes a run.
propOptTip: Searches the design variables for the best trade-off between the two objectives (a Pareto front, not one weighted number). Each design is one blade-element evaluation of about half a second: population x (generations + 1) evaluations, at most 200. Every evaluation is stored in your workspace.
propOptTipMachLimitTip: The limit is an unconfirmed owner input; the value here overrides it for this run only.
optRangeInvertedTip: The minimum must be below the maximum. The run cannot start until the range is fixed.
optRangeNowTip: Current value of the loaded motor (from {src}). The search starts from the current design, so it should be inside the range.
optRangeNowOutsideTip: The search starts from the current design (from {src}), so its value should be inside the range. Widen the range, or use the reset button to set it around the current value.
optRunBlockedInverted: Cannot start: min is above max for {names}. Fix the range first.
propDesignPolarTip: Section polar of the blade-element model. Flat plate: generic lift and drag. With camber: the zero-lift angle of each airfoil from thin-airfoil theory; drag and stall stay generic. Viscous (mfoil): lift, drag and stall of each airfoil from a panel and boundary-layer model, by Reynolds number. All are models.
meshPresetUnavailable: Presets are not available for this machine
meshPresetOpenMesh: Switch the preset on the Mesh tab
propStoredRunsTip: Runs kept in the workspace, also runs computed as server jobs. Best feasible value per diameter against rpm; open a run to see how it converged.
propRunsNone: No stored runs for this motor and objective
propRunsMap: Best feasible value against rpm, one line per diameter
sweepResultSettingsTip: The preset, steps per electrical period and gap rows this result was computed with. A sweep saved before this label existed shows the settings of its stored request.
coggingPpTip: Adds the cogging torque peak-to-peak (N·m) of each geometry: one extra no-load solve per geometry, shared by all its currents, with the same magnet temperature, steps and mesh as the loaded points. The loaded points are not replaced. The table also shows it as a percentage of the point's own torque. A value at 48 steps is for ranking only. This is the no-load, full-strength-magnets figure; it reads about 3 to 6 % lower than a normal no-load run with demagnetisation on (measured in two cases).
coggingPpRankingTip: Ranking only: not a final cogging value. A final value needs 120 or more steps per period at 20 C.
coggingPpMissing: No Cogging pp for this geometry: its no-load solve was refused or failed. The loaded values are unchanged.
coggingPpMixed: Cogging pp values were measured with different settings (steps, magnet temperature, mesh); they are not ranked against each other.
coggingPpBasis: No-load, full-strength magnets (demagnetisation at load not applied). It reads about 3 to 6 % lower than a normal no-load run with demagnetisation on (measured in two cases).
sweepFailBound: a size does not fit its bound
sweepPresetError: The run settings could not be resolved, so the run cannot start.
sweepMixedSettings: These results were computed at different steps per period or gap rows (or one is not on the Optimization preset); they are not ranked against each other.
shaftConvMixed: These results use different shaft-power conventions (core loss on the shaft and the 3-D factor in the run, or an earlier run with every loss on the electrical side); they are not ranked against each other.
runSettingsFinalists: finalists need at least {n} steps per period (6 samples per cogging cycle); a finalist whose slip ring has no suitable divisor keeps the run's {run} and is flagged insufficient
runSettingsHelp: The run uses exactly the values the Mesh and Simulation tabs hold now: steps per period, gap rows, wire cell, mesh sizes and sectors. They are labelled by the server (Optimization preset, Simulation preset, or custom) and cannot be changed here: use Change in Mesh. The other settings are shown with where they come from.
runSettingsStale: The run settings changed since they were shown. They are refreshed; check them and press Run again.
runSettingsMagnetHelp: Magnet temperature of the run: the number typed in the Simulation tab, or, when that field is blank, the assigned magnet card as the library writes it (the card's own temperature). It is the same temperature a single Simulation run would use and is stored with the run.
runSettingsUnknown: unknown: {what} not set in the Mesh / Simulation tab, Run is disabled
runSettingsReasonRippleUnrecorded: the ripple grade, {cycles} cogging cycles x {samples}; source not recorded
propFlagTip_unconverged_elements: Some blade elements found no momentum solution; they carry an estimate without induction. The numbers are not a design point.
propFlagTip_uninduced_estimate: Elements without a momentum solution are counted with the blade-element load at zero induction (an estimate).
propFlagTip_w_re_not_converged: The loop between the local speed and the Reynolds number of the section polar did not settle within its passes.
propFlagTip_polar_alpha_gap: The viscous section model did not converge at some angles of attack used here; values there are interpolated across the gap.
propFlagTip_polar_beyond_table: Some sections work at angles of attack outside the viscous table; the values there are extrapolated.
propFlagTip_re_outside_tables: Some sections work at a Reynolds number outside the viscous tables; the nearest table is used.
propFlagTip_tip_mach_beyond_polar_model: The tip Mach number is above the validity of the viscous tables (computed at Mach 0).
propConstraint_torque_reached_at_cap: Torque reached at the speed cap
